lines.h1: Tiimo or TickTick? Here's the answer in ten seconds.
lines.h2: Want one app for tasks, calendar, habits and a focus timer? TickTick.
lines.h3: Need a calm, visual day built for neurodivergent brains? Tiimo.
lines.h4: Now, five rounds to prove it. Plus one bonus round, where a third app comes in.
lines.r1b: Tiimo is designed for neurodivergent people first, and says it was co-designed with ADHD and autism experts.
lines.r1c: TickTick is a general productivity app that a lot of ADHD people rely on.
lines.r2b: Tiimo lays your day out as a visual schedule, morning, day and evening, with soft icons instead of a wall of text.
lines.r2c: TickTick has calendar views too, but it starts from lists and boards.
lines.r2d: For time blindness, round to Tiimo.
lines.r3a: Round three. Everything in one place.
lines.r3b: TickTick puts tasks, a calendar, habits, a priority matrix and reminders in one app.
lines.r3c: Tiimo stays focused on planning your day and your routines.
lines.r3d: If you want one system for everything, round to TickTick.
lines.r4b: TickTick has a Pomodoro timer with white noise.
lines.r4c: Tiimo's visual countdown sits right on your home or lock screen.
lines.r4d: Both do it well. This one's a tie.
lines.r5a: Round five. Works on every device.
lines.r5b: TickTick runs on iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux and the web.
lines.r5c: Tiimo covers iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and Android, plus the web.
lines.r5d: If you switch between computers all day, round to TickTick.
lines.sc: Two rounds each, and a tie. So don't pick the better app. Pick the one built for your problem.
lines.b1: One more round. The moment you freeze on a task you've been avoiding.
lines.b2: Both can break work down with AI now. But both start from organizing, your day in Tiimo, your lists in TickTick.
lines.f1: Full disclosure, that's the gap we built FOCO for. It starts from the task you're putting off.
lines.f2: It breaks the task into tiny steps, each with a time estimate.
lines.f3: Then step one opens into a focus session, with a timer and a companion working next to you.
lines.o1: So. Tiimo for a calm, visual day. TickTick for one system that holds everything.
lines.o2: And FOCO when the plan is fine, but you still can't begin. Tell me in the comments which one you are.
